Results.ReviewText:
Very happy with this purchase. Grill has been used on picnics, beach days, and road trips so far. Feeding a family of 5 with the 1200 and the size has been perfect for our expectations. I dont think there is a better road grill on the market. For years we used the coleman roadtrip. The coleman was bulky to load in the vehicle and hard to keep clean after cooking. 

Another great Weber product. Buy with confidence.
Results.Title: Buy with Confidence

Results.ReviewText: This product is great, didn’t expect to be even close to what i got!!!
Results.Title: Best purchase ever

Results.ReviewText: We were limited on space in the trailer, we have a larger Weber at home and love how it cooks. So we bought the Q1200 and we can Cook for 4 people , Weber is dependable and easy to clean…..love it!
Results.Title: Compact and great for the trailer

Results.ReviewText: Sturdy. reliable. well made. Not too heavy. Easily adapted to run off 20# tank.
Results.Title: Solid grill

Results.ReviewText: Cooks very evenly. Great temperature control. Easy to clean.
Results.Title: Great Little Grill for RV Camping

Results.ReviewText: Great little portable grill however, I use it everyday, and unless it is cleaned regularly, grease from inside the grill will collect along the burners and travel out the gas line and drip all over your patio. I had another Weber grill that didn't do this........but this little grill seems prone to dripping grease along the gas line.
Results.Title: Great little grill except

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. We are very sorry about the issue installing the propane tank. Our Care team is here to help. We will be following up soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: There was a problem with the ability to put the propane tank on the space between the handle, and the screw and was too tight. We were sent a package of the new propane, mild and instructions. It was a pain in the butt I would rather have sent it back and received a new one.’
Results.Title: Just boughrProblem with parts on the machine

Results.ReviewText: Perfect for my campervan. Size and performance is spot on. Simple and easy to use, and it cooks great! Got the griddle accessory, normally have grill on one side and griddle on the other. The griddle is great for vegies and potatoes.
Results.Title: I like it!

Results.ReviewText: After first weekend we are loving it!  Will continue to cook on it
Results.Title: 1st Weekend

Results.ReviewText: I love this little grill!  It may be small but the quality speaks for itself.  So well made…. Great for camping or up on my pool deck.   LOVE IT!  Perfect size for me and my boyfriend and would work well for a small family also!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Just love our new grill!  Cook great, cleans easily and looks nice.
Results.Title: Q1200 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: I had a Q100 forfvifteen years and it was a great grill but this new one is even better! The little improvements that have been made make such a difference. The grill being split and the protection of the gas heating element from drippings is fantastic. I can easily remove and soak the grill halves in my sink and wipe them clean after each use. This will allow me to enjoy this grill for even longer than my original one. Also, the side, fold out tables are super convenient.
Results.Title: Great grill.

Results.ReviewText: I like that that it can get hot faster than my previous grill (Weber Spirit).  Right now it is trickier to get the grill to a desired temperature but I guess that will get better with practice.  It is very easy to burn yourself by touching the hot lid.
Results.Title: Lots of heat

Results.ReviewText: Best tailgater out there.  I bought this for a camping trip and have already used it at least (6) times in the last month at multiple Brewer games and in my own backyard.  It heats up fast, holds temp because of the grates and clean up is a breeze.  I love this grill.
Results.Title: Tailgater

Results.ReviewText:
Je me suis procurée le Weber fin juin et je l’adore!!! 

C’est le parfait petit bbq puisque qu’il est petit, performant et facilement déplaçable. Que ce soit pour des petits balcons d’appartement ou pour le camping, je l’utilise à plusieurs occasions.

Il est facile à nettoyer et les grilles sont solides.
Results.Title: Petit, pratique et performant

Results.ReviewText: I have used only on 1 camp out. Performed as expected.
Results.Title: Works great

Results.ReviewText: We replaced our larger Weber (gave it to relatives to enjoy) with this more compact one as we don’t need a big grill.  This one is perfect! It’s easy to clean, move, store and cook on. We ordered the table and cover and will probably get the griddle accessory at a later date. Comes in fun colors too.
Results.Title: Downsize Weber

Results.ReviewText: It’s perfect, perfect size, great for traveling. We are taking it on trips when we stay in Verbo’s or long trips and have lunch on the side of the road. We found a case for it on Amazon that hold the grill, tools and small propane bottles. Everything is quality cast aluminum, not the cheap tin like most grills. You can get a griddle for one side and cook eggs or whatever, colors are cool too!!
Results.Title: The perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: Overall very happy with my choice to buy this with the collapsible cart. I've had a spirt 3 burner for about a decade at my house, got this for an apartment I'm at. Weber quality and performance all around. I did buy the hose adapter for a full size tank and cover. Looking to grow into more accessories for it.
Results.Title: Fun Size Weber Quality

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for us as an older couple. We have always used a larger grill but as the children left that big grill was a bit much for a single streak or a couple of burgers. We did the research and discovered this Weber. It seems to be perfect for our Lani/patio and cooks great!
Results.Title: Top Rated Small Gas Grill is Tops

Results.ReviewText: Very nice compact grill . Doesnt take up a lot of space . Great for taking on road trips . Cooks great . Not good for huge party . But does good for a few people .
Results.Title: Weber Q1200

Results.ReviewText: We bought this a month ago and we absolutely love it. It’s perfect for at home or camping. Very easy to take anywhere.
Results.Title: Totally recommend

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. I've been using it in my camper it's easy to store and heats up quickly and cleans up easy just what I needed
Results.Title: Outstanding

Results.ReviewText: Bought this on sale and got my moneys worth in the first week!
Results.Title: Best Portable Grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Thia is my second weber 



This is my second Weber Q . There is nothing wrong with the old one but I wanted a new one with shelves.
Results.Title: Weber Q 1200

Results.ReviewText: Purchased when the snow was still around, finally out camping and this works great
Results.Title: Works great !!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for my balcony deck. Good heat range. Heats quickly. Controls laid out nicely. I use it with a hose to a 20lb tank. Made some amazing cheeseburgers tonight. Very happy with my Q.
Results.Title: Perfect size. Awesome performance.

Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, works well, loved the exterior thermometer, good looking, perfect size, high quality, food tastes great on this Weber.
Results.Title: Good Cookin’

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are very sorry to hear your grill is not working. This is not the quality we expect from our products. Our Care team is reaching out to assist you further. Please look for our outreach soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Weber grills

Results.ReviewText: My 2nd weber Q1200 quit working! I only had the unit less than a year
Results.Title: Unhappy Weber Q1200 fan

Results.ReviewText:
Great grill. Bought to replace a 30 year old Baby Q.
Needed more cooking surface but didnt want a full size grill.
Results.Title: Q 1200 rocks

Results.ReviewText: tres contente de l achat, mais pas de photo a vous presenter, vous connaissez deja le produit peu pu m en passer.
Results.Title: super pour faire cuisine dehors j adore merci

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill with air miles money! What a great investment ! A friend recommended Weber Barbecues to me. I was able to to feed my whole family with it . Small and compact and easy to move iir easily. I can do everything on it I did with a regular sized one . Absolutely love it !
Results.Title: Great little barbeque

Results.ReviewText: I love this Weber grill. This is my second Weber. My first Weber was the larger one but this smaller size fits my needs now and it is perfect for me.
Results.Title: 1200 series Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: I got this for my birthday from my kids… great bbq for tailgating or camping
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill!  I’ve had a couple of these before and they are great!  I wanted a new one to put in my camper. I will say the previous ones were built a bit stronger and sturdier. I hope this one stands up to the many hours of use I got out of the others.  Btw. I am still using the previous one. I did have to replace the ignition but other than that it still works great.
Results.Title: Great Grill.

Results.ReviewText: We owned a WeberQ 1200 for years but never bothered to keep it clean so over time it got so bad I just wanted to buy a new one. This version has nice grilling plates that are easy to clean. And the cover I bought for it is made of a pliable material unlike the plastic one that turned hard on us over the years. It was easy to put together and set up and works well.
Results.Title: Nice little grill

Results.ReviewText: We love it! Enough space on the quality grill top for the two of us and another couple. Fits on a small tabletop outside our door and can easily be moved… best choice in the small style of gas grill.
Results.Title: Happy!

Results.ReviewText: Love this small, but all around great version of Weber grills. Needed a compact grill and this was very capable, with all the requirements for a very satisfying and results oriented grilling experience. Highly recommend.
Results.Title: Just What I Needed.

Results.ReviewText: Does not reach 500•F, otherwise, beyond expectations
Results.Title: Honest review

Results.ReviewText: My Weber Grill is easy to use, and does everything that larger and more expensive grills do. Get one - you won't be disappointed.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber 1200 gas grill purchased with 6 ft extension for larger propane tank
Results.Title: Brand new colors!!
